sloka: तया विहीनः कृपणः कथम् लक्ष्मण धारये ।य माम् अनुगता रज्यात् भ्रष्टम् विहत चेतसम् ॥४-१-१०८॥
transliteration: tayā vihīnaḥ kṛpaṇaḥ katham lakṣmaṇa dhāraye ।ya mām anugatā rajyāt bhraṣṭam vihata cetasam ॥4-1-108॥

translations.english: 'She followed me, O Lakshmana as I was deposed from the kingdom and distraught. Now helpless, how can I live without her?
